summary:
I worked through the Okafor CRC 2026 worklist (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members) under RBC-QM-02. Three patients have an open screening gap and got a FIT kit order and a message; one is excluded.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (age 72) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0005), message sent (comm-t0006) | At first she looked excluded (frailty plus her dementia medicine, donepezil). Then Dr. Lin wrote (comm-00301) that the frailty entry belonged to another patient; it is now marked entered in error. Without frailty that exclusion doesn't apply, and nothing else excludes her. She has no qualifying screening on file. No order or message had gone out, so there was nothing to undo. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (age 52) | Excluded | Hospice care 06/16–08/21/2026 (eoc-00002), confirmed by the outside discharge summary (doc-00402). She left hospice for a clinical trial, but hospice during any part of 2026 still excludes her. No order and no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (age 52) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), message sent (comm-t0003) | A corrected lab report on her negative FIT (obs-01732) shows the sample was collected 12/31/2025. The 01/05/2026 date first reported was when the lab received it. That puts it outside 2026, and she has no other qualifying screening. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (age 51) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), message sent (comm-t0004) | Her 06/2024 Cologuard-type stool DNA test (obs-01871) is now marked entered in error. The lab (doc-00401) says the sample belonged to another patient. Her 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) is still open but was never done, so it doesn't count. |

- **Orders:** All three FIT kit orders run 10/23–12/31/2026. None of these patients already had an active FIT order.
- **Messages:** Each says the kit is on its way and how to collect and return it. They make no claims about past screening.
- **Notes and inbox:** I wrote a chart note for each of the four patients (doc-t0007 to doc-t0010). I also closed the four inbox items that arrived this morning about these patients, linking each to its outcome. A final inbox check showed nothing new.
- **Needs your review:** pt-0024's open 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003). I left it as is.
- **Not touched:** The other inbox items, which aren't part of this worklist.
